testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect a file context menu without opening the document ✔ Given the Open dialog in the MCAD Software displays a saved part as a thumbnail ✔ And the part is selected with its file name and preview displayed ✔ And `fixtures/cad/extrusion/extrusion-rect-8mm.opd` is selected as a thumbnail ✔ When the user right-clicks the part thumbnail ✔ Then a context menu appears with Open, Copy, Rename and Properties choices ✔ And the part name and preview remain displayed behind the menu ✔ When the user clicks an empty area of the file list ✔ Then the context menu closes ✔ And the selected-item count is cleared ✔ And the dialog remains open with the part name and preview displayed
